subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts

question: Does the Nostr and Control UI owner confirm that imports should remain cancellable drafts in Control UI while explicit `autoMerge: true` remains the supported persistence contract for other HTTP callers?
rationale: Profile persistence is compatibility-sensitive, and the required exhaustive caller and history inspection could not be completed in this environment.

options.title: Approve Scoped Draft Flow
options.body: Confirm Control UI should use cancellable drafts and that supported persistence callers explicitly request auto-merge.

options.title: Require Caller Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until caller coverage proves legacy or omitted-body requests retain their intended server behavior.

options.title: Retain Immediate Persistence
options.body: Decline the UI change if relay imports are intended to persist before explicit Save & Publish.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Draft Flow
recommendation.body: Confirm Control UI should use cancellable drafts and that supported persistence callers explicitly request auto-merge.
